text: Record visibility per CRM module: Public, Public Read Only (new), Hierarchy.

Approval approvers: Users, Role, Groups, Levels (new: "Reporting depth — how many levels up the reporting chain to ask"), Manager, Record Owner, User Lookup Field, "Assign to the submitter's manager".

Workflow email recipients: Users, Org Units, Roles, Profiles, User fields, Teams, "Roles and subordinates" — no record owner's manager. Blueprint owners: users / "Allow record owner" — no Reporting Manager.
No text for Share Data with Peers, Transfer & Delete, subordinate prompts on delete/suspend or profile change, or "Reporting To" in views/filters/reports.
